verdict.rationale: The FTB's online services (MyFTB, Web Pay) are a transactional portal that could plausibly offer event-triggered rules such as automatic payments or alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording Akamai 403 walls at robots.txt and the application host, with no documentation of any rule or trigger capability. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
